title: NFTLoyalty
tagline: Empowering brand loyalty with NFTs: Enhance user engagement through digital rewards and experience seamless, gasless transactions.
description:
This project is focussed on  brand loyalty programs by leveraging the power of NFTs.The Decentralized Loyalty Hub (DLH) will allow entertainment brands (and potentially other sectors in the future) to run loyalty programs seamlessly with a combination of NFT-based rewards and point systems, enabling users to engage with brands more interactively and transparently.

 We identified the need for a more immersive and interactive rewards system, which not only boosts user engagement but also offers tangible, digital collectible rewards in the form of NFTs. By integrating gasless transactions through Safe and Gelato Relay, we ensure a seamless and cost-efficient user experience.

Brands can onboard through an intuitive dashboard where they mint NFTs by uploading assets and setting metadata. Users register on the platform and, post-registration, can report their brand interactions to earn points. When enough points are accumulated, users can redeem their desired NFTs. The highlight is the gasless redemption process, made possible by our integration with Gelato Relay. Brands sponsor the transaction fees, ensuring a smooth redemption process for users without them incurring any costs.
how_its_made: We've utilized Solidity for our core smart contracts which handle NFT minting, points accumulation, and redemption. Our application runs on the Ethereum Blockchain. The user interface is built with React. Most notably, we've integrated Safe Account Abstraction for gasless transactions which partnered with the Gelato Network using their Gelato Relay to facilitate sponsored transactions. This ensures that users redeeming NFTs don't bear transaction costs, enhancing their overall experience.
